style_prefix: Bleak workplace-noir science-fiction illustration, ink-wash shadows, restrained rust red and monitor amber against cold blue-gray metal, tactile paper receipts, worn industrial surfaces, dry humane observation, readable silhouettes, abstract interface bars and symbols.

prompts.prompt: Wide view into a compact Mars corporate welfare records booth: pale treatment console on the west wall, dark calibration rack on the east wall, steel counter in the middle, ribbed observation window and raven aviary to the north, two-sided sample drawer beneath the glass, red shred slot beside the south door.

Middle-aged brown-skinned woman in a worn blue-gray contractor coat counts seven numbered medication seals beside six amber console marks; a glossy black raven with a silver right-leg band taps a perch beyond ribbed glass above a bandaged juvenile.

Records booth routine: animal-care clerk at the west treatment console, lean older technician with orange diagnostic lens opening a jammed east-side thermal printer, tall black-uniformed containment lead occupying the south doorway, raven watching through north glass.

High three-quarter choice frame over a steel counter: seven medication seals, a north-wall sample drawer to a raven perch, a jammed east thermal printer, and a green west-console confirmation field form four reachable actions around one careful clerk.

Wide branch-aware work frame in the rectangular booth: clerk stacking west-side tickets, technician clearing east-side scraps, containment lead watching from the south lane, raven waiting by the north sample drawer, warm lamp over an empty evidence-joining surface.

Object closeup under a warm lamp: burn-marked maintenance glove holds a thin thermal fault strip; ink-stained fingers hold a numbered treatment seal; both show matching geometric time bars; black-gloved manager hand approaches; raven eye watches through ribbed glass.

Overhead custody puzzle in a compact records booth: treatment ticket and thermal fault strip on a steel counter, cleaning roster under a pen, red shred slot by the south door, orange lens case at the east rack, sample drawer to a raven at the north window, manager approaching.

Gray-jacketed silver-haired auditor enters the south door with an airgapped slate beside the black-uniformed containment lead; care clerk stands west, calibrator east, black raven north beyond glass; the steel counter exposes the empty joining surface between them.

Tense records-booth decision: clerk faces matching paper receipts under a lamp, north sample drawer to a raven, microphone edge of an auditor slate, and green close-count field; manager controls center lane while calibrator waits beside east rack.

Formal audit aftermath divided by amber and cold blue light: sealed slate near south door, care clerk at central counter, technician under personnel light at east rack, containment lead near the clerk's badge, ravens watching through the north ribbed window.

Low view centered on the two-sided steel sample drawer: glossy black raven with silver leg band reaches from the north perch, numbered treatment seal waits under the lamp, auditor aims a slate, black-gloved containment lead reaches, care clerk holds drawer handle.

Care clerk speaks matching timecodes into a gray-jacketed auditor's slate; technician stays silent by the east calibration rack; containment lead studies both workers; raven waits through ribbed north glass; paired abstract time bars glow on the slate.

Late-shift booth under low blue-gray light: clerk and black raven face each other across ribbed glass and a partly open sample drawer; folded thermal receipt survives behind the lower perch bracket; west console, east rack, red shred slot, and empty steel counter surround the tiny route.
